title: Optimal convergence rates in periodic homogenization of nonconvex Hamilton--Jacobi equations
body_text:
Optimal convergence rates in periodic homogenization of nonconvex Hamilton--Jacobi equations

We study the convergence rates in periodic homogenization of general nonconvex, coercive Hamilton--Jacobi equations. We show that the optimal convergence rate is $O(\varepsilon^{1/2})$ in one dimension, $O(\varepsilon^{1/3})$ in two dimensions (up to a logarithmic factor), and $O(\varepsilon^{1/3})$ in dimension three or higher.

Authors: Jiwoong Jang, Qi Sun, Hung V. Tran, Yifeng Yu
